description: This file defines utility functions, macros, enums, and inline functions for the lighttpd server project, including socket handling, URL decoding, string manipulation, and error handling.

methods.name: li_fatal
methods.description: Logs a fatal error message, prints backtrace if available, and aborts execution.

methods.name: li_print_backtrace_stderr
methods.description: Prints a backtrace to STDERR if libunwind is available.

methods.name: li_fd_init
methods.description: Initializes a file descriptor with O_NONBLOCK and FD_CLOEXEC flags.

methods.name: li_fd_no_block
methods.description: Sets a file descriptor to non-blocking mode.

methods.name: li_fd_block
methods.description: Sets a file descriptor to blocking mode.

methods.name: li_fd_close_on_exec
methods.description: Sets a file descriptor to close on exec.

methods.name: li_send_fd
methods.description: Sends a file descriptor over a Unix socket.

methods.name: li_receive_fd
methods.description: Receives a file descriptor over a Unix socket.

methods.name: li_url_decode
methods.description: Decodes URL-encoded characters in a string.

methods.name: li_path_simplify
methods.description: Simplifies a filesystem path.

methods.name: li_querystring_find
methods.description: Finds the value for a given key in a query string.

methods.name: li_counter_format
methods.description: Formats a guint64 counter value into a string based on the specified type.

methods.name: li_string_destroy_notify
methods.description: Destroys a string with notification.

methods.name: li_hash_binary_len
methods.description: Calculates the length of binary data for hashing.

methods.name: li_hash_ipv4
methods.description: Hashes an IPv4 address.

methods.name: li_hash_ipv6
methods.description: Hashes an IPv6 address.

methods.name: li_hash_sockaddr
methods.description: Hashes a socket address.

methods.name: li_equal_sockaddr
methods.description: Compares two socket addresses for equality.

methods.name: li_sockaddr_to_string
methods.description: Converts a socket address to a human-readable string.

methods.name: li_sockaddr_from_string
methods.description: Creates a socket address from a string.

methods.name: li_sockaddr_local_from_socket
methods.description: Gets local socket address from a socket.

methods.name: li_sockaddr_remote_from_socket
methods.description: Gets remote socket address from a socket.

methods.name: li_sockaddr_clear
methods.description: Clears a socket address.

methods.name: li_sockaddr_dup
methods.description: Duplicates a socket address.

methods.name: li_ipv4_in_ipv4_net
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address is in a given IPv4 network.

methods.name: li_ipv6_in_ipv6_net
methods.description: Checks if an IPv6 address is in a given IPv6 network.

methods.name: li_ipv6_in_ipv4_net
methods.description: Checks if an IPv6 address is in an IPv4 network.

methods.name: li_ipv4_in_ipv6_net
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address is in an IPv6 network.

methods.name: li_gstring_replace_char_with_str_len
methods.description: Replaces a character in a GString with a string of specified length.

methods.name: li_const_gstring
methods.description: Creates a GString from a constant string without copying.

methods.name: li_strncase_equal
methods.description: Case-insensitive comparison of GString and string.

methods.name: li_string_assign_len
methods.description: Assigns a string of specified length to a GString.

methods.name: li_string_prefix
methods.description: Checks if a GString has a given prefix.

methods.name: li_string_suffix
methods.description: Checks if a GString has a given suffix.

methods.name: li_string_append_int
methods.description: Appends an integer value to a GString.

methods.name: li_apr_sha1_base64
methods.description: Computes SHA1 hash and encodes in base64.

methods.name: li_apr_md5_crypt
methods.description: Performs MD5 crypt hashing.

methods.name: li_safe_crypt
methods.description: Performs safe crypt hashing with salt.

methods.name: li_g_string_append_len
methods.description: Appends a string of specified length to a GString.

methods.name: li_g_string_clear
methods.description: Clears a GString.

methods.name: li_g_string_free
methods.description: Frees a GString.

methods.name: li_g_queue_merge
methods.description: Merges two GQueues.

methods.name: li_remove_path
methods.description: Removes the path from a file path string.

methods.name: li_sys_error_quark
methods.description: Returns the GQuark for system errors.

methods.name: _li_set_sys_error
methods.description: Sets a system error with message, file, and line info.
